canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; contains the browser chrome strip at its top edge and the web page content below.

layers.description: Browser chrome strip along the window top: three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the browser window, docked to its top edge, spanning the full window width; the app card sits below it.

layers.description: A centered white application card with a thin light border, rounded corners and a subtle shadow; it holds the whole todo app.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered horizontally in the browser content area below the chrome; contains the card header, create row, error banner and list container stacked top to bottom.

layers.description: Card header band with the app title "My Todos" in large dark sans-serif text aligned to the left with padding.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child inside the app card, directly under its top edge; title aligned to the card left padding.

layers.description: Create row with a single-line text input showing grey placeholder text "Add a new todo…", a blue filled button labeled "Add" immediately to the right of the input, and small grey helper text "Up to 500 characters" under the input.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the header; input and button share one horizontal line, helper text left-aligned under the input.

layers.description: Rounded list container with a hairline border holding exactly four todo rows stacked vertically with thin dividers, oldest at the top; the list contains exactly four rows and nothing else, and the word Cancel appears nowhere in the image.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the error banner, spanning the card inner width; owns all four todo rows in creation order; the banner above it belongs to the app card, not to any row.

layers.description: Todo row 1 of 4, first in creation order, done: a checked blue box with white tick at the left, todo text "Buy milk" in faded grey crossed by a single thin horizontal strikethrough line crossing the middle of the text, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child of the list container; checkbox left-aligned, text left-aligned after the checkbox, action buttons right-aligned; same row layout grid as all other rows.

layers.description: Todo row 2 of 4, done: a checked blue box with white tick at the left, todo text "Pay electricity bill" in faded grey crossed by a single thin horizontal strikethrough line crossing the middle of the text, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Second child of the list container directly below the first row; identical layout grid to the first row.

layers.description: Todo row 3 of 4, not-done: an empty unchecked box with a grey border at the left, todo text "Walk the dog" in solid dark text with no strikethrough line on this row, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Third child of the list container directly below the second row; identical layout grid to the first row.

layers.description: Todo row 4 of 4, newest at the bottom, not-done: an empty unchecked box with a grey border at the left, todo text "Read 20 pages" in solid dark text with no strikethrough line on this row, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end; this row is rendered unchanged like every other row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Fourth and last child of the list container; identical layout grid to the first row; nothing renders below this row inside the container.

layers.description: Stale-operation error banner: a light-red rounded rectangle strip inside the app card positioned above the list container in the gap under the create row, containing one small line of dark-red text reading "Todo does not exist" left-aligned with padding; the banner is not a todo row, has no checkbox, no divider and no buttons, and this string is rendered exactly once in the whole image.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the app card, stacked between the create row and the list container, spanning the card inner width; the list container and its four rows sit entirely below it.
